activities.anchor: The wall between news and opinion is not prudishness; it is the balance
activities.caption: slide between the blurred format and the labelled contract
activities.name: nvWallCompare

config.prompt: Slide between the two business models of attention — and what each does to trust.

before.label: Blurred for reach
before.text: Opinion travels: engagement metrics reward provocation and certainty, so commercial pressure pushes every format toward confident advocacy — whatever label it wears.

after.label: Labelled contract
after.text: Trust is the durable asset: audiences selectively avoid news they perceive as biased, and clearly separated, transparently labelled journalism ranks higher year on year.

config.why: The wall between news and opinion is not prudishness; it is the balance sheet — slow to build, quick to spend, impossible to buy back at the same price.
